description: This file defines the Styles class responsible for generating the styles.xml content within the OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) writer of PhpSpreadsheet. It creates XML output for spreadsheet styles, including namespace declarations and style sections.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: Handles writing styles.xml for ODS files by generating the required XML structure and namespace declarations.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the styles.xml content as an XML string, including namespace attributes and style sections.
